title: Kula Today
heading: Today · Tue 17 Nov
summary: A light day (forecast light). Thermals stayed light all day. The upslope ran from about 08:30 to about 16:30. Yesterday evening, the page called it normal, about 4,900 ft, a hit. Midday the base averaged about 4,900 ft by the Kekoa camera, right on yesterday evening's number; the morning update said about 4,900 ft and was right on; at 10:00, from the 09:00 base, about 4,600 ft, off by 300 ft. Most of the day the shear line was crossing Kula Highway near Omaopio; furthest north about 14:52, crossing Kula Highway near Kamehameha Schools. Data gaps: no readings all day from 3 stations (Kahikinui, Nakula, Upper Kahikinui); the Mesonet could not be reached on 6 of 55 updates.
